name: Form
description: A form from the Forms page: contact, newsletter or any form you build, with the fields, spam protection and emails managed in Studio.

fields.name: Layout
fields.helpText: default stacks the fields. inline puts a single field and the button on one row, for a sign-up.

fields.name: Form
fields.helpText: The key of the form on the Forms page, for example "contact" or "newsletter".

fields.name: Text
fields.helpText: What the visitor gets, or what happens next.

fields.name: Consent
fields.helpText: One line with a privacy link, shown under the button. Inline links only.

fields.name: Success title
fields.helpText: Shown above the form's own confirmation text. Defaults to "Thank you".
